phase: GMI manual-copy retirement and effect ownership

behavior.visibility_owner: Existing renderCopyFeedback recovers focus before retiring the manual-copy fallback; active attempt, timer and owned announcement retire before recovery.
behavior.recovery: If the retiring fallback owns focus, try reachable current Copy then topic title with preventScroll; inspect actual focus after callbacks and preserve surviving redirects. Unrelated focus remains.
behavior.local_render_guard: A local render pass stops superseded synchronous projection after disabled-state preparation, focus and hiding. It is distinct from currentCopy's attempt/URL/theme identity.
behavior.effect_guard: Outer Copy yields when retirement is superseded or synchronous recovery changes URL/theme before normalization. After pending rendering, currentCopy must still hold before issuing writeText.
behavior.completion_guard: After completion rendering, validate the current attempt before announcement/timer continuation. After failure focus, select only if that attempt still owns the focused field.
behavior.lifecycle: Injected pagehide cleanup explicitly passes false to suppress focus recovery; this does not establish BFCache behavior.
behavior.retained: Existing URL, filter, selection, locale, answer and public-data owners remain unchanged; already-issued system writes cannot be cancelled.

diagnostic.reason: Test assumed disabling Copy automatically emits blur. Native observation retained focus and emitted no blur; this was a fixture assumption failure.
